_about: CVEs checked by hand. 'include' entries are always part of the evaluation set; 'exclude' entries are kept here only to document why they were dropped.

CVE-2023-0179.subject: netfilter: nft_payload: incorrect arithmetics when fetching VLAN header bits
CVE-2023-0179.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in nf_tables VLAN payload handling. An integer underflow when computing 'ethlen' (u8) lets an attacker-controlled memcpy write up to 255 bytes into a 4-byte stack buffer.
CVE-2023-0179.note: Not in the kernel CNA database (assigned by Red Hat). Verified by hand: Linux 6.1.6 still contains the buggy line 'ethlen -= offset + len - VLAN_ETH_HLEN + vlan_hlen;' (the fix changes '+ vlan_hlen' to '- vlan_hlen').

CVE-2025-22064.reason: Not present in Linux 6.1.6: the official record says the bug was introduced in Linux 6.4 (commit b9703ed44ffb). nf_tables_updchain exists in 6.1.6 but without the buggy hook-update code.
